# T2F inbound protocol fixture (R3 columns reauthor)

This directory is a compact, versioned, source-only Python fixture for the frozen cbe-inbound-call/1 protocol. It was reauthored after the independent T2F blocker review, before T2C implementation. AUTHOR_DRAFT.json is the only oracle artifact present; a fresh isolated Sol reviewer must independently validate it and create the final oracle.json plus MANIFEST.sha256. Those final files are intentionally absent here.

The active exhaustive denominator is every ast.Call in the three compact source units (base.py, calls.py, and zero_calls.py), enumerated with Python's standard-library AST. The 45 sites cover direct/import/module exact bindings; self/cls dispatch; a child with no local member and C3 inheritance; a complete diamond; incomplete MRO; final class/method; annotated Base, plain forward "Base", imported-qualified base_module.Base, optional forms, unsupported Base | Other; unrelated same-name and missing-member negatives; self.backend.save() and ordinary attribute chains; factory, subscript, dynamic attribute/import, exec, external builtins; nested/default/module/class/decorator calls; wrapper decoration; and the zero-call unit. Labels were manually assigned from the frozen T2A rules using only source and stdlib AST. No Codebase Explorer parser, IR, reverse-edge, renderer, generated analysis, or generated documentation output was used.

SOURCE_MANIFEST.sha256 contains sorted sha256  path entries for the three active source files.
